description: The Berbers build strength through tribal alliances, trade and adaptable armies. Tribal Tents anchor influence, while alliance choices unlock specialized troops. Combine Tuareg, camel warriors and Saharan traders, then develop landmark bonuses to support a flexible economy and army.
author: hosein81 and marcokistan

bonuses: Tribal Tents anchor the influence network.
Choose tribal alliances and specialized troops.
Saharan traders and unique landmarks support development.
